has logo

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasLogo
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasLogo
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/images

The media object that serves as an entity's logo — its emblematic, identity-bearing image. An organization, software project, dataset, place, or product may carry one. Distinct from gmeow:depicts: a logo represents the entity rather than picturing it; it is therefore NOT a subproperty of gmeow:isAbout.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Entity -> gmeow:MediaObject

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hasLogo from gmeow:Entity to gmeow:MediaObject when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Entity, gmeow:MediaObject
